en: A donor flies with its own row: its speed, gravity, damage and explosions. Only the projectile changes; the weapon keeps its fire rate, magazine and sounds, and guided rounds do not inherit their weapon's lock-on.
zh: 供体按其自身的数据行飞行：速度、重力、伤害和爆炸均为其自身的。只有弹体改变；武器保留其射速、弹匣和音效，制导弹药不会继承其原武器的锁定。

en: Projectile donors (Eagle payloads, orbital shells, sentry rounds, weapons' second projectiles) are not live-tested: choosing one writes allow_unverified_reference and allow_unverified_effect.
zh: 弹体供体（飞鹰载荷、轨道炮弹、哨戒炮弹药、武器的第二弹体）均未经实机测试：选择其中之一会写入 allow_unverified_reference 和 allow_unverified_effect。

en: The programmable projectile is a projectile donor HD2Runtime 0.30 has not live-tested yet; Runtime requires this opt-in for it.
zh: 该可编程弹体是 HD2Runtime 0.30 尚未实机测试的弹体供体；Runtime 要求为其加上此选择性加入。
哪个模组较慢（始终开启）

en: HD2Runtime times every call into a mod (event listeners, timers, keybinds, its main file, custom stratagem callbacks) and every update it runs for the mod's operations. The report lists each mod and the Runtime's own work, the most time first.
zh: HD2Runtime 会为每次调用模组（事件监听、计时器、按键绑定、主文件、自定义战略配备回调）以及为模组操作运行的每次更新计时。报告按耗时从多到少列出每个模组以及 Runtime 自身的工作。

en: A single call of 8 ms or more, or a mod averaging 1 ms or more per update over 10 s, logs a PERFORMANCE line naming the mod and the callback.
zh: 单次调用耗时 8 毫秒或以上，或某模组在 10 秒内平均每次更新耗时 1 毫秒或以上时，会记录一行 PERFORMANCE，指出该模组和回调。

en: When a mission ends, logs the three owners that used the most CPU time (hd2.diagnostics.performance, always on).
zh: 任务结束时，记录占用 CPU 时间最多的三个所有者（hd2.diagnostics.performance，始终开启）。

en: hd2.resources.image(id) names images/ID.png of the mod, packed as a complete icon family; hd2.resources.model(id) names a custom model. ModBuilder builds both for custom stratagems (Custom Content); a hand-written reference needs those files in the mod.
